finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full crash.**

`redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` dropped at `02:14:07` ([logs/app.log:3](logs/app.log:3)). Cache fell back to direct store reads, which couldn't keep up.

From there queue depth climbed steadily past its `500` cap and `TimeoutError`s piled up every few seconds. 12 reconnect attempts to redis all failed, last one at `02:31:26`.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` and restarted. Eight seconds later the `api` process went unresponsive and `supervisor` killed the whole process group, taking the service down ([logs/app.log:717-719](logs/app.log:717)).

Root cause: redis never came back. Next step is finding why redis at `10.0.0.12` stayed unreachable for 17+ minutes.
